title: Shared database integrator and global certification
missingGapNotes: TenantAdminController domains CRUD (6 endpoints): /api/v1/superadmin/tenant/domains — no vNext equivalent for domain CRUD and verification flows
TenantAdminController settings (9 endpoints): /api/v1/superadmin/tenant/settings/* — no vNext equivalent for global/org/college settings management
SuperAdminUserAdminController (7 endpoints): /api/v1/superadmin/users/* — no vNext equivalent for faculty-admin lifecycle, impersonation flows
ModuleAccessController detailed ops (5 endpoints): GET/PUT node, learner-overrides, history, explain — only tree and bulk exist in vNext
SuperAdminLogsController digest/deploys (5 endpoints): context, deploys, deploys/health, digest, digest/send — not present in tracker module
AuthController switch/handoff (4 endpoints): /auth/switch, /auth/switch-token, /auth/handoff/consume, /auth/revoke-sessions — vNext has no org-switch or handoff flows
Organization individual CRUD (3 endpoints): fetch/{id}, update/{id}, delete/{id} — only create and list exist
Contacts by program/department (2 endpoints): learnerContactsByProgramId, facultyContactsByDeptId — no direct equivalent
FeatureFlagController mine (1): /api/v1/features/mine — no per-user feature flag endpoint
SuperAdminFeatureController modules (1): /superadmin/features/modules — modules listing not present
ClientErrorReportController (1): /api/v1/client-errors/report — no client error reporting endpoint
PublicE2eAuthController (1): /public/e2e/auth/superadmin — e2e superadmin login not in public namespace
